title: Jorjani invited to join the Knights of Malta in an initiation ritual in Malta
summary: Jason Jorjani tells of Jorjani invited to join the Knights of Malta in an initiation ritual in Malta, about unspecified at Malta, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Yeah. I was invited, by the way, to join the Knights of Malta at one point.

plain: A researcher named Jason Jorjani, speaking on the podcast of host Jesse Michels in 2025, mentions in passing that he was once invited to join the Knights of Malta, a centuries-old Catholic order of knights, through an initiation in Malta. He gives no date and few details. People retell it because, if true, it would mean an old and secretive order took an interest in a researcher of hidden UFO history.
